```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(raster)
library(terra)
library(here)
here()
```

```{r}
#Load data ####

bng <- 27700

#Load NFI/LCM2015 master map
map <- raster(here("data/derived-data/2015-spatial-layers/edge_core_raster_all_tiles_EW.tif"))
crs(map) <- bng

#Load roads at 1km scale
a_roads <- raster(here("data/derived-data/2015-spatial-layers/Ard_1000_mosaic_all_tiles_corrected.tif"))
crs(a_roads) <- bng
b_roads <- raster(here("data/derived-data/2015-spatial-layers/Brd_1000_mosaic_all_tiles_corrected.tif"))
crs(b_roads) <- bng
motorways <- raster(here("data/derived-data/2015-spatial-layers/motorway_1000_mosaic_all_tiles_corrected.tif"))
crs(motorways) <- bng

#Load nearest urban
nearest_urban <- raster(here("data/derived-data/2015-spatial-layers/nearest_urban_raster_2015_all_tiles_corrected.tif"))
crs(nearest_urban) <- bng
nearest_suburb <- raster(here("data/derived-data/2015-spatial-layers/nearest_suburban_raster_2015_all_tiles_corrected.tif"))
crs(nearest_suburb) <- bng

#Load linear features at 1km scale
lf <- raster(here("data/derived-data/2015-spatial-layers/linear_features/lf_1000_mosaic_all_tiles_corrected.tif"))
crs(lf) <- bng

#Load MAX DAMS at 1km scale
dams <- raster(here("data/derived-data/2015-spatial-layers/Max_DAMS/focal.dams.1000.max.tif"))

#Load landscape nutritional scores for raster categories
#Edge forage quality scores sum of woodland score + adjacent land cover score
edge.val.types <- read.csv(file.path(here("data/raw-data/Expert_derived_quality_ranks_edge_types.csv")))

#Read in woodland polygon dataset
#Combined NFI 2015 and LCM 2015 woodlands

hab_patches_all <- st_read(here("data/derived-data/nfi_lcm_overlaid_shapefile_woods_export.shp"))

head(hab_patches_all)

hab_patches_all <- hab_patches_all %>%
  rename(patch_ID = Id) %>%
```


```{r}
#Buffer all woods by 10km
buffered_woods_10km <- st_as_sf(st_buffer(woods, dist = 10000))  # dist = 10km in meters
#Buffer all woods by 12km (10km landscape + 2km edge buffer)
buffered_woods_12km <- st_as_sf(st_buffer(woods, dist = 12000))  # dist = 10km in meters

#ensure crs of buffers is BNG
st_crs(buffered_woods_12km) <- bng
st_crs(buffered_woods_10km) <- bng

#Check points, woodlands buffers line up
plot(st_geometry(buffered_woods_12km), col = NA)
plot(st_geometry(woods), col = "black", add = TRUE)
#plot(st_geometry(wood_points), add = TRUE, col = "red")

```

```{r}
# Cropped rasters list to store results

#Should we set a centre point for each woodland and crop around that to make a square?
#At the moment it is buffering to the edge of the woodland, making an irregular shaped buffer.

buffered_cropped_rasters <- list()

# Loop through each buffered buffer and crop all rasters
for (i in seq_along(buffered_woods_12km$geometry)) {
  buffer_geometry <- buffered_woods_12km$geometry[i]
  
  # Convert buffer geometry to a spatial object that raster can use
  buffer_extent <- as(extent(st_bbox(buffer_geometry)), "Extent")
  
  # Crop each raster to the current buffer extent
  map_cropped <- crop(map, buffer_extent)
  a_roads_cropped <- crop(a_roads, buffer_extent)
  b_roads_cropped <- crop(b_roads, buffer_extent)
  motorways_cropped <- crop(motorways, buffer_extent)
  nearest_urban_cropped <- crop(nearest_urban, buffer_extent)
  nearest_suburb_cropped <- crop(nearest_suburb, buffer_extent)
  lf_cropped <- crop(lf, buffer_extent)
  dams_cropped <- crop(dams, buffer_extent)
  
  # Store the cropped rasters in the list, using the buffer name as the key
  buffered_cropped_rasters[[paste("buffer", buffered_woods_12km$patch_ID[i])]] <- list(
    map = map_cropped,
    a_roads = a_roads_cropped,
    b_roads = b_roads_cropped,
    motorways = motorways_cropped,
    nearest_urban = nearest_urban_cropped,
    nearest_suburb = nearest_suburb_cropped,
    lf = lf_cropped,
    dams = dams_cropped
  )
}

plot(buffered_cropped_rasters[[1]]$map)
plot(buffered_woods_12km$geometry[1,], add=TRUE, border="blue", lwd=2, col=NA)
```

### Extract raster variables for all woodlands in 10km buffer

#### Use 12km buffered raster for extractions

```{r}
# Function to convert 'RasterLayer' to 'SpatRaster'
convert_to_spatraster <- function(raster) {
  if (!inherits(raster, "SpatRaster")) {  # If not already 'SpatRaster'
    terra::rast(raster)  # Convert to 'SpatRaster'
  } else {
    raster  # If it's already a 'SpatRaster'
  }
}

# Function to apply conversion to all elements in a sub-list
convert_sublist <- function(sublist) {
  lapply(sublist, convert_to_spatraster)  # Apply conversion to each item in the sub-list
}

# Convert each sub-list in the main list
buffered_cropped_rasters_spat <- lapply(buffered_cropped_rasters, convert_sublist)
```

```{r}

plot(nearest_urban_cropped_spat)
```

### #Calculate connectivity for every woodland inside the 10km buffers

#### #Use source patches from 12km buffer

```{r}
#### SET CONNECTIVITY PARAMETERS ####
# connectivity parametetrs - % of dispersers reaching a set distance #
percentage_dispersers <- 0.05 ### 5%
dispersal_distance <- 434 #Gets curve up to 1000m on x axis
dispersal_contribution <-
  -((log(1 / percentage_dispersers)) / dispersal_distance)

# Buffer distance represents the cut off - this stops the script measuring every pairwise combination
dispersal_cutoff <- 0.999 ### 99.9% cut off
#buffer_cutoff <-
  #round(log(1 / (1 - dispersal_cutoff)) / (log(1 / percentage_dispersers) /
                                             #dispersal_distance), digits = 2)
buffer_cutoff = 1000 #1km

# test & plot of dispersal contribution for sequence of distance up to buffer_cutoff
test <-
  data.frame(distance = (seq(0, buffer_cutoff, by = 0.5))) %>%
  mutate(contribution = (exp(dispersal_contribution * distance) * 100))

ggplot(data = test, aes(x = distance, y = contribution, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = buffer_cutoff, color = "red")

#See how buffer size looks
focal_patch_buffer <- st_buffer(hab_patches[1,], buffer_cutoff)
plot(st_geometry(focal_patch_buffer))
plot(st_geometry(hab_patches[1,]),add=TRUE)

```

```{r}

connectivity_results <- list()

# Initialize progress bar
pb <- progress_bar$new(
  format = "[:bar] :current/:total (:percent) in :elapsed, eta: :eta",
  total = num_patches,
  clear = FALSE,   # Keep the progress bar on the screen
  width = 60
)

# Loop through each 10km square
for (i in seq_along(buffered_woods_10km$geometry)) {
  # Get the unbuffered woodland (10km square)
  focal_wood_geometry <- buffered_woods_10km$geometry[i]

  # Use the 12km buffer as the source patches area
  source_woods <- st_filter(hab_patches_all, buffered_woods_12km[i, ], .predicate = st_intersects)

  # Crop the woodlands in the original 10km square to get the focal patches
  focal_woods <- st_filter(hab_patches_all, focal_wood_geometry, .predicate = st_within)

  # Calculate connectivity for each focal woodland
  Connectivity_table <- NULL

  # Initialize a progress bar
  num_focal_woods <- nrow(focal_woods)
  pb <- progress_bar$new(
    format = "[:bar] :current/:total (:percent) in :elapsed, eta: :eta",
    total = num_focal_woods,
    clear = FALSE,
    width = 60
  )

  # Loop through each focal woodland to calculate connectivity
  for (j in 1:num_focal_woods) {
    pb$tick()  # Update the progress bar
    
    # Focal patch in the 10km square
    focal_patch <- focal_woods[j, ]
    
    # Buffer around the focal patch to include source patches
    focal_patch_buffer <- st_buffer(focal_patch, buffer_cutoff)
    
    # Find source patches within this buffer
    source_patches <- st_filter(source_woods, focal_patch_buffer, .predicate = st_intersects)
    
    # Calculate distances between the focal and source patches
    patch_dist <- as.vector(st_distance(focal_patch, source_patches))
    
    # Create a data frame for connectivity information
    Conn_table_site <- data.frame(
      focal_patch = focal_patch$patch_ID,
      focal_patch_area = as.numeric(focal_patch$patch_area),
      source_patch = source_patches$patch_ID,
      source_patch_area = as.numeric(source_patches$patch_area),
      distance = patch_dist,
      incoming_connect = ifelse(
        focal_patch$patch_ID == source_patches$patch_ID,
        NA,
        source_patches$patch_area * exp(dispersal_contribution * patch_dist)
      )
    )
    
    # Append to 'Connectivity_table'
    if (is.null(Connectivity_table)) {
      Connectivity_table <- Conn_table_site
    } else {
      Connectivity_table <- rbind(Connectivity_table, Conn_table_site)
    }
  }

  # Store results for this tile
  connectivity_results[[paste("Wood", buffered_woods_10km$patch_ID[i])]] <- Connectivity_table
}
```
